title: US100 realized-variance-asymmetry response environment correction

research_height.transfer_path: sixteen completed US100 M15 signed-return energies -> four subsequent market-bar proxy economics -> at most one later standalone additive-entry information seed

correction_not_adjacent_successor.fault: The stable P1 path stopped normally with 24,099,625 valid ticks, 1,529 resolved observations, zero observer or detailed-history fault and stable governing inputs, but the HTML quality label remained 99% rather than the frozen 100% requirement. P2-P4 and every aggregate direction metric remained unopened.
correction_not_adjacent_successor.contradictory_environment_evidence: Unit 094 independently completed the same US100 2024 carrier with 65,421,654 valid ticks, a 100% real-ticks HTML label, zero faults and a stable exercised-history manifest. The target hypothesis therefore lacked a valid environment verdict, not an economic verdict.
correction_not_adjacent_successor.current_policy_reason_for_correction: Environment, design and engineering faults are correction states with no arbitrary retry cap and cannot be promoted into economic research failure. Unit 105 established the repository precedent of correcting an invalid fresh-observer environment through an immutable family-owned M15 bar-open/spread proxy while preserving the parent signal and gates.

premetric_operator_correction.event: During readiness inspection, a Get-Content header preview printed the parent CSV header plus its first two complete rows, exposing their economic columns before this declaration.
premetric_operator_correction.why_nonselective: The exact observer, both symmetric direction books, four periods, costs and gates were already frozen by Units 032 and 096. The two rows had mixed row-level direction signs and were not aggregated or used to select, tune or suppress anything.
premetric_operator_correction.formal_input_correction: The family-owned structural anchor contains only fourteen non-economic timing, count, energy and direction fields. No parent entry, exit, spread, profit or calc field may be read by the formal process.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Selected only to finish one still-unanswered fixed economic question after substantial perspective distance through Units 097-119. It changes no formula neighbor and does not reopen Units 102, 103, 105, 108, 111 or 112.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: GSCPI is strong-null, ADS is nonconcordant and RORO is not causally backfillable. A further external-state substitution is less ready than correcting an economically unread exact contract.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: No new synchronized order, quote, queue, session or pending-reservation mechanism has sufficient natural evidence.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: No new previsible uncontaminated held-position checkpoint exists; this four-bar response is an observation horizon, not an exit rule.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Weight, risk, ladder, cap, occupancy, admission and capital-partition neighborhoods remain closed. Unit 120 uses fixed 0.01 observation volume and no portfolio reconstruction.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Environment correction and structural parity are integrity inside Program 1, not a diagnostic-only candidate.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and all heights. Do not automatically open a threshold, window, sign count, estimator, horizon, direction, period, cost, symbol, stop, sizing or integration successor.

parent_provenance.role: exact fixed hypothesis and terminal decisions
exact observer semantics only; never executed or included by Unit 120
independent proof that authoritative US100 2024 history can produce a stable 100% real-tick path

structural_anchor.allowed_role: P1 engineering parity only. It contains no entry bid, ask, spread, exit price, profit or calculation field.

fixed_observer.evaluation_clock: At each available US100 M15 bar open, use only sixteen completed continuous returns ending at the immediately completed bar.
fixed_observer.continuity: The current bar and seventeen required completed closes must be separated by exactly 900 seconds at every adjacency; session reopens and discontinuities are excluded.
fixed_observer.return_definition: For completed bars k=1 through 16, natural log of close[k] divided by close[k+1].
fixed_observer.positive_energy: Sum of squared strictly positive returns.
fixed_observer.negative_energy: Sum of squared strictly negative returns.
fixed_observer.zero_returns: Excluded from sign counts and both energies.
fixed_observer.trigger: While idle, absolute variance imbalance at least 0.35 after both sign-count minima.
fixed_observer.dominant_variance_direction: BUY for positive imbalance and SELL for negative imbalance.
fixed_observer.horizon: Resolve on the fourth subsequent physical US100 M15 market row. Closed-market time creates no synthetic bars.
fixed_observer.overlap: At most one unresolved observation; the resolving bar may immediately evaluate a new signal.

fixed_proxy_execution.bid: The acquired M15 open is the entry and resolution bid proxy.
fixed_proxy_execution.ask: Bid plus the acquired spread points multiplied by the frozen symbol point.
fixed_proxy_execution.observed_buy: Open at entry ask and close at resolution bid.
fixed_proxy_execution.observed_sell: Open at entry bid and close at resolution ask.
fixed_proxy_execution.double_spread: Move entry and resolution one additional full observed spread against the direction, exactly matching the parent stress arithmetic.
fixed_proxy_execution.profit: Signed price distance divided by trade tick size, multiplied by trade tick value and fixed 0.01 volume.
fixed_proxy_execution.currency_rounding: Emulate USD OrderCalcProfit at two decimals per observation using decimal half-up rounding.
fixed_proxy_execution.authority_limit: Immutable bar-open/spread proxy only. A pass is one information seed, not real-tick fill evidence, MT5 confirmation, implementation or promotion authority.

acquisition_contract.copy_rule: One physical minimal copy from the neutral Lab runtime. No executable, source, settings, state, log or runtime dependency from Live, Optimization or another Lab family.
acquisition_contract.request: One US100 TIMEFRAME_M15 copy_rates_range call from 2023-12-01 00:00:00 through 2026-07-31 23:59:59 UTC request coordinates.
acquisition_contract.forbidden_api_calls: Every account, position, order, deal, history-deal, margin, check, send or trading-state API.
acquisition_contract.freeze: Hash the bar export, visible symbol specification, scripts, structural anchor and acquisition receipt before the sole formal aggregation.

implementation.role: One bounded market-data acquisition and one structural-integrity-first fixed economic aggregation. Neither is a test harness, reusable validator, promotion checker, trading executable or general CLI.

premetric_implementation_correction.trigger: The first structural-only invocation reproduced every P1 aggregate and matched entries 1-1005, then stopped because parent opportunity 1006 resolved on the 23:15 M15 bar at its first valid tick 23:18:08 while the proxy records the bar-open coordinate 23:15:00.
premetric_implementation_correction.fault: The comparator cleared seconds but did not floor the parent's delayed first-tick minute to its containing 15-minute bar.
premetric_implementation_correction.correction: Floor the parent resolve timestamp to its containing 15-minute coordinate before comparing it with the proxy resolution bar. Exact tick timestamps remain descriptive; entry/window coordinates, four physical bars, sign counts, energies, imbalance and directions are unchanged.

requirements: Every declared parent, script and structural-anchor byte/hash pin matches.
The acquired bar and symbol-spec byte/hash pins match the acquisition receipt; epochs are unique and strictly increasing; OHLC is finite and positive; volume and spread are nonnegative.
US100 remains digits 2, point 0.01, tick size 0.01, tick value 0.01, contract size 1.0 and minimum/step volume 0.01.
P1 reproduces 128 eligible days, 4,916 eligible evaluations, 11,703 finalized bars, 1,530 triggers, 1,529 resolutions, one unresolved tail and zero rate fault.

All 1,529 P1 window-end, entry and resolution M15 coordinates, four-bar horizons, sign counts and direction identities match the non-economic parent anchor; energy error is at most 5e-12 and imbalance error at most 5e-10.
Every period has zero rate fault and resolved equals triggers minus at most one unresolved tail.
fixed_integrity_gate.failure_meaning: Engineering, environment or design correction with no economic verdict and no arbitrary retry cap while the economic contract remains unchanged.

fixed_aggregation.path_metrics: Eligible days/evaluations, resolved opportunities and frequency; observed and doubled-spread net, wins, losses, zeros, gross profit/loss, PF and maximum closed drawdown.
fixed_aggregation.pooled_metrics: Concatenate fixed 0.01 rows without compounding and calculate the same metrics plus positive-path count and maximum positive-path contribution share.
fixed_aggregation.maximum_closed_drawdown: Largest peak-to-subsequent-trough decline in the ordered closed cumulative proxy-profit path, starting from zero.

frequency: At least 0.40 resolved opportunities per eligible variance day pooled.
At least 0.25 resolved opportunities per eligible variance day in at least three of four paths.
economic_for_one_direction: Positive doubled-spread net in at least three of four paths.
Pooled doubled-spread net divided by maximum closed drawdown at least 1.50.
No path contributes more than 70 percent of total positive-path doubled-spread profit.
fixed_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by higher pooled doubled-spread net, then PF, then positive paths, then lexicographic direction name.
fixed_selection_gate.pass_action: Retain one unopened standalone additive-entry information seed only; close and recompare the whole map before any separate Optimization proxy or dedicated non-Master Strategy Tester.
fixed_selection_gate.failure_action: Retain no realized-variance-asymmetry seed and close the full fixed axis economically.

stop_rules: This declaration is frozen before dedicated market acquisition and before any Unit 120 bar-open price, spread, profit, direction aggregate or verdict.
Declaration through closure is one research unit and receives one main commit/push after closure, not at internal acquisition or correction boundaries.
Acquire one immutable M15 surface, freeze its receipt, then run exactly one valid structural-integrity-first aggregation. Corrections producing no valid economics do not consume an economic rerun.
Do not formally inspect or aggregate any parent invalid economic column.
Do not query broker/account/position/order/deal state, read the Live research ledger, touch Master, alter Program 6 or mutate Live/Optimization.
